proposal.summary: AVEVA InTouch Access Anywhere <= 2020 R2 is vulnerable to a path traversal that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to read files outside the secure gateway web server.
proposal.affected_product: AVEVA InTouch Access Anywhere versions 2020 R2 and older
proposal.cwe_quote: are vulnerable to a path traversal exploit that could allow an unauthenticated user with network access to read files on the system outside of the secure gateway web server.

AV.quote: an unauthenticated user with network access

S.quote: read files on the system outside of the secure gateway web server.

C.quote: read files on the system outside of the secure gateway web server.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vendor advisory and proof-of-concept details, reproduce the issue in a test environment to identify affected endpoints and full impact, and coordinate mitigations or patches with AVEVA.
